name: Takanemaru
source:
Takanemaru is Menou's tutor.
He possesses a taciturn and cold aura, but he also has a very strong sense of responsibility and takes care of Menou very thoroughly. [spoiler] He's somehow connected to the queen, and appears to be hiding something from Menou since her childhood. As the queen's death approaches, Takanemaru begins to show some level of unrest. [/spoiler]

[Based on the tanslation of the official website profile.]
